label: Basic
description: A basic combobox with a list of options. Best for the minimal single pick: the field opens a sheet whose search box is focused at once, filtering as you type, with a message when nothing matches.

label: Disabled
description: A disabled combobox. Best for a locked field that neither opens its sheet nor takes a search.

label: Invalid
description: A combobox in an invalid state. Best for a labelled field marked invalid, with a message under it that screen readers announce.

label: Clear Button
description: A combobox with a clear button. Best for a field preset to Next.js whose X empties it, the X standing in for the chevron while a value is set.

label: Auto-Highlight
description: A combobox with auto-highlight. Best for the first match tinted as you type, so the keyboard's Return key picks it.

label: Grouped Options
description: A combobox with grouped options. Best for timezones listed under Americas, Europe and Asia Pacific headings, the search narrowing every region.

label: Group Separators
description: A combobox with grouped options and separators. Best for the regional timezone list with a thin rule between the groups.

label: Large List
description: A combobox with a large list of options. Best for a generated list of 100 entries that scrolls inside the sheet and narrows as you type.

label: Icon Addon
description: A combobox with its own glyph. Best for a leading globe glyph in the field in place of the search glyph.

label: Country Picker
description: A country picker. Best for a field that shows the chosen flag and name, with a search placeholder that says what to type.

label: In Form
description: A combobox in a form. Best for a labelled required field read back when Submit is pressed, with its message shown only after a try.

label: Multi-Select
description: A multi-select combobox. Best for a chip for each chosen framework with an X on each, more added from the sheet's search.

label: Disabled Multi-Select
description: A disabled multi-select combobox. Best for a locked field holding 2 preset chips whose remove buttons are disabled too.

label: Invalid Multi-Select
description: A multi-select combobox in an invalid state. Best for the chip field in its error state, with a message below while nothing is chosen.

label: Non-Removable Chips
description: A multi-select with chips that cannot be removed. Best for preset chips drawn without an X button; the sheet is the one place to change them.

label: Custom Items
description: A combobox with rich rows. Best for a member picker whose field shows the chosen avatar, with rows listing each person's avatar, name and job title.

label: In Dialog
description: A combobox in a dialog. Best for a framework pick in a dialog with a hidden label and Cancel and Confirm buttons in its footer.

label: Custom Trigger Icon
description: A combobox with an up and down chevron. Best for a chevrons glyph shown while the field is empty, giving way to the X once a value is picked.

label: User Tags
description: A multi-select combobox with member tags. Best for team members as pill chips with a small avatar, picked from rows that show each person's position.

label: Invisible Tags
description: A borderless combobox with member tags. Best for a field with no border or fill, its member chips sitting loose on the screen.

label: Status Change
description: A status change combobox. Best for workflow states from Backlog to Cancelled, each with its own tinted circle glyph in the field and the list.

label: Priority Change
description: A priority change combobox. Best for priority levels drawn as signal bars, with Urgent shown as a yellow warning sign.

label: Lead Selection
description: A lead selection combobox. Best for a single lead picked from a Team members group of avatar rows, marked You for the signed in person, or No lead.

label: Member Selection
description: A multi-member selection combobox. Best for several people summed up in the field as up to 4 stacked avatars and a member count.

label: Date Selection
description: A due date combobox with a custom date. Best for presets such as Tomorrow and End of month beside their dates, plus a Custom row that brings in a date field with its own calendar sheet.

label: Label Selection
description: A multi-label combobox with a no-label state. Best for issue labels marked by colored dots, the field showing one label's name or up to 3 dots and a count of the rest.

label: Team Selection
description: A team selection combobox. Best for one owning team per record, each marked by its own tinted tile, with a No team row to unset it.

label: Assignee Selection
description: An assignee selection combobox. Best for a single assignee chosen from avatar rows, with No assignee on top and an Invite row in its own New user group.
